text: {random} made a mean joke at {self} for the 5th time this week, and now {self} is upset at them.
Convince {random} to cut it out.
Promise {random} a shiny new tool if they stop.
{self} accidently dropped an iron hammer on {random}'s toe, prompting a fight.
Tell {self} to make iron slippers for all customers entering the shop.
Enforce safety procedures stating all tools must be at ground level or 5 meters away from any customers.
The {blacksmith} requested that {self} bring wood for the furnace so he could make a new axe, but {self} doesn't have an axe!
Give {self} a spare axe.
Give {blacksmith} some spare wood.
{self} wants to make a wooden desk for studying, but doesn't have any wood!
Give {self} some wood to make a wooden desk.
Give {self} some gold to buy wood.
{self} accidently cut themselves badly, and are bleeding profusely!
Give {self} some potions to fully heal up.
Get one of the best doctors around to treat {self}.
A rat got into {self}'s home and stole all their food!
Give {self} some food.
Give {self} some weapons and tell them to go steal it back.
{random} started at {self} for a couple hours, making them extremely uncomfortable.
Give {random} a shiny potion to look at instead.
Give {self} an axe to defend themselves.
{self} was drying their clothes when a random bird swooped in and stole specficially only their undergarments.
Buy {self} some new undergarments.
Steal {random}'s undergarments and give it to {self} for free.
{self} was accidently injured while working!
Give them a potion to heal up quickly.
Take a "careless tax" from them and tell them to be more careful in the future.
{self} has complained about their house being too creaky!
Give {self} some wood to try and fix up their house.
Suggest a small renovation, tearing up the creaky wood and making it a storage space.
{self} recently got in a fight with their neighbor, leading to their house having multiple large gaping holes in the roof.
Give {self} wood to fix their house.
Tell {self} to stuff the holes up with random dry food.
{self} is complaining that they don't own any weapons.
Give {self} a weapon.
Try and convince them that money is the true power in the world.
{self} thinks that blacksmiths are more useful, while {lumberjack} thinks that lumberjacks are more useful.
Give {lumberjack} a cool axe to convince him blacksmiths are better.
Give {self} some wood for the furnace to convince him lumberjacks are better.
{self} accidently created a black hole, endangering the village!
Trade some potions with the black hole for some money, neutralizing the black hole.
Throw a bunch of money at the black hole to bribe it to go away.
{self} wants some test dummies to test his new spell out on.
Throw some healing potions on {random} and use them as a test dummy.
Make some test dummies from wood.
